| [NOTE-366](../../../record/notes.d/NOTE-366.md) | Primer | Squaring the feed-forward ReLU and adding a causal width-3 depthwise convolution after each per-head Q/K/V projection makes decoder-only LMs reach a vanilla baseline's quality in 1.75–2.3× less compute at 35M, at least 1.8× at 110M and 4.2× at 537M. That last figure is at fixed size, where the factor grows with training length. At 1.9B, against a GELU baseline, it takes ⅓ of the compute.
